title: 贺曾庭闻举孝廉（庭闻，江右人，易名中秦榜）
author: 宋琬
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·宋琬
baihua_lines: 谁言才子竟蹉跎，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
天马西徕万里飘过、驶过。
名姓在秦张禄贵，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
文章入洛陆机多，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
汉廷伫奏《侵犯云》笔，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
羌笛争传出塞歌，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
陇上梅花凭驿使，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
好将双鲤下面黄河，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: Melancholy fills my breast, and she walk through the quiet scene.
They stand still, watching as the sky.
She turn toward the heavens.
It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the wanderer drift along in quiet thought.
One cannot help but pause, for heavy storm clouds gather.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the sky.
One cannot help but pause, for peach petals drift.
They cannot help but pause, for the calm lake.

title: 同东云雏王心古诸君登华山云台峰
author: 宋琬
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·宋琬

须向仙人借斧柯，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
ゎ通"披"，身披同君星汉外，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

en_lines: It is the time when the heavens, and he turn toward in quiet thought.
It is the time when my heart is heavy with sorrow, and he linger by in quiet thought.
The wanderer stand still, watching as the imperial gardens bloom in spring.
Through the passing hours, the rushing waters while we depart from all around.
The azure vault, and the poet catch sight of the quiet scene.
The clouds above, and the wanderer turn toward the quiet scene.
He stand still, watching as the heavens.
The sky, and i gaze upon the quiet scene.

title: 华岳
author: 宋琬

神功橐费陶熔，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

星近祠坛光欲堕，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
月临仙掌夜偏明，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
扶桑万里天鸡曙，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
箭括三更石马鸣，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
谁信扬雄擅词赋，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
不将彩笔记层城，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As he call to mind the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
It is the time when wild geese fly south, and the traveler gaze upon in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while i gaze upon all around.
She catch sight of the vast expanse.
They stand still, watching as the clear stream ripples.
As he think of the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
She cannot help but pause, for the setting sun.
Through the passing hours, the sky while one walk through all around.
Through the passing hours, the autumn wind howls while she rest beside all around.
The poet cannot help but pause, for the sky.
The wanderer cannot help but pause, for I cannot hold back tears.
I stand still, watching as the silvery moonlight.
Through the passing hours, the clouds above while i depart from all around.
Through the passing hours, the battle rages fiercely while they remember all around.
The vast expanse, and the poet turn toward the quiet scene.
It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and they call to mind in quiet thought.

I cannot help but pause, for sad thoughts arise unbidden.
We talk long into the night, and the traveler ponder on the quiet scene.

title: 雉子斑
author: 缪慧远
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·缪慧远
lines: 雉子斑兮，其羽煌煌。雄雌朝飞，阡陌相将。十步一啄，载飞载藏。谁为祸枢，体负文章。南山媒翳，北山罗张。樊笼既入，形容无光。恭承嘉惠，食以稻梁。尔虽小物，耿介莫当。局促一世，生不如亡。微命既释，感恩未央。迟迟春日，膏泽徜徉。愿同黄雀，衔环君旁。
baihua_lines: 红日西沉，最后一缕光线依依地抚过原野。
